name: November
objective: Long commitments in the softest Mumbai month, without a Black Friday percentage.
strategy:
Black Friday, Strong Monday.

Commercial job: Long commitments in the softest Mumbai month, without a Black Friday percentage.

Newcomer: Black Friday Week Zero (“Seven days unlimited, fully credited, then 20% off.”). Black Friday urgency on a credited intro, with an upgrade path built in.

Winback: High-Value Homecoming (“A manager call, the year's best long-plan price and a private.”). These clients bought big before; a long plan at a serious price fits them.

Renewal: Commitment Issues? Solved. (“Black Friday to Strong Monday: the year's best prices on long plans.”). November is Kwality's trough (₹18.5L in 2025). Four days of the year's best long-plan prices bring December–March cash forward without discounting 1 Month.

Renewal: 11% on 11.11 (“One day only: 11% off, and one more class on us.”). Singles' Day reads in India as a self-purchase day; a 24-hour window creates urgency.
notes:
Moment: Club Nine last seats reopen Fri 26 Nov; 'Strong Monday' strength class on Mon 29 Nov; 11.11 'Party of One' self-gift day.
Build: new clients 34 buyers × ₹12,000 = ₹4.1L; reactivation 30 × ₹11,468 = ₹3.4L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹2.8L; renewals ₹16.2L. First visits needed 114 vs 125 last year (0.91×); CRM leads needed 228 vs 125 last year.
